# Hermes et le cerveau

Real outputs the `hermes_cerveau` step reads (`app/src-tauri/src/hermes_brain.rs`), from Hermes
v0.22.3 in a throwaway HOME, paths shown as `/Users/someone`.

- `MEMORY.md`: written by Hermes's own memory tool (`MemoryStore.add`, twice), byte for byte:
  entries split by `\n§\n`, no newline at the end. Hermes counted it 95 of its 2,200 characters.
- `config-get-memory.json`: `hermes config get memory --json`.
- `config-path.txt`: `hermes config path`.

The persona is made up (Awa Ndiaye, a pastry shop in Thiès).
